rules.sentence: Synovial fluid analysis showing elevated WBC count or a high percentage of polymorphonuclear cells significantly increases the likelihood of a diagnosis of septic arthritis resulting in orthopedic consultation, antibiotic therapy, and admission.[9]
Septic arthritis can be confirmed with a positive Gram stain and culture, which will help guide antibiotic therapy.
